# QRLoop

> 100% free dynamic QR code generator platform with lifetime active redirects, real-time scan analytics, and lossless vector SVG exports.

QRLoop empowers creators, businesses, and developers to generate trackable QR codes, edit destination URLs after printing, analyze visitor telemetry (device category, operating system, browser, city), and export print-ready assets without paywalls or trial expirations.

## Docs

- [Dynamic QR Code Studio](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/dynamic-qr): Interactive studio to create customizable dynamic QR codes with live redirects
- [Static QR Code Generator](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/static-qr): Free offline QR code generator for Wi-Fi credentials, vCards, and plain text
- [QR Code Knowledge Hub](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/blog): Technical guides on QR design, print specs, 10:1 scanning ratio, and comparison
- [Platform Comparison Matrix](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/compare): Feature and pricing comparison between QRLoop and paid commercial alternatives
- [About QRLoop](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/about): Technical architecture, mission statement, and sub-50ms HTTP 302 edge routing
- [Privacy Policy](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy policy, GDPR/CCPA data rights, and Google AdSense disclosures
- [Terms of Service](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/terms): Terms of service and dynamic QR redirect usage policy
- [Contact Support](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/contact): Support desk, feedback form, and security report channel
- [Restaurant Solutions](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/qr-code-for-restaurants): Contactless digital menu QR codes with instant updates
- [Event Solutions](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/qr-code-for-events): Conference and event check-in badges with live routing
- [Wi-Fi Solutions](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/qr-code-for-wifi): Instant Wi-Fi access QR codes for guest networks
- [Business Card Solutions](https://qrloop4.vercel.app/qr-code-for-business-cards): Digital business card vCards with vector print exports
